data.cultural_impact: The name Ishtiyaq holds significant cultural relevance in the Islamic community, especially in the context of Sufism. Sufism, also known as Islamic mysticism, is a practice aimed at achieving a deeper connection with the Divine through love and devotion. The name Ishtiyaq reflects the deep longing and yearning that a Sufi experienced in pursuing this spiritual path. It also highlights the idea of seeking knowledge, wisdom, and ultimately, closeness to Allah, as mentioned in the Quran (4:164).
data.spiritual_significance: Ishtiyaq's meaning holds immense spiritual significance as it represents the intense longing and yearning for God, the ultimate goal and purpose of a spiritual seeker. The name symbolizes the unrelenting thirst to quench the spiritual void within oneself, striving to achieve closeness to Allah and His infinite love and mercy. In this quest for spiritual fulfillment, the name Ishtiyaq serves as a constant reminder to remain humbled and devoted in the presence of the Almighty, recognizing our insignificance in the grand scheme of the universe and the infinite greatness of the Divine.
